title: Das Nachlassinventar Erzherzog Ferdinands II. (1529-1595) von 1596
author: Estate inventory of Archduke Ferdinand II of Tyrol
notes: Inventory manuscript (KHM shelfmark KK_6652) of the possessions of Archduke Ferdinand II of Tyrol (1529-1595), drawn up in 1596 at Innsbruck and Ambras, digitised with a full-text transcription in the repository viewer. The viewer sits behind a bot check, so the pages are best opened in a browser; the plain-text API returns the whole transcription. Word count is our own, from that plain text (about 106,500 words, including folio labels). Status active: the repository and its DOI (registered under the recent 10.60477 prefix) are live in 2026.
